CompanyPage.title: Company history
CompanyPage.description: The story of SOFIN and the “Yangi asr” farm — from its agricultural roots to modern dairy production, technology, growth and long-term development.

intro.title: The foundation of the “Yangi asr” farm
intro.paragraph1: The “Yangi asr” farm was established in 2000 under decision K-5/840 of the Kyzyltepa district administration in the Vang'ozi citizens' assembly.
intro.paragraph2: The head of the farm, Temirov Jobir Jamolovich, was born on May 11, 1973 in Navoi region, Kyzyltepa district, Vang'ozi MFY. He holds a secondary specialized education and graduated from the Bukhara Banking College.
intro.paragraph3: At the beginning, the farm included 80 heads of cattle, 35 hectares of cotton fields, 45 hectares of grain fields and 60 hectares of pastureland used for livestock feed.

foundation.title: Establishment of the farm
foundation.text: In 2000, the farm began its activity by combining livestock farming and agriculture. Its early structure was built around land resources, cattle and feed capacity.

import.title: Import of pedigree cattle and expansion
import.text: During President Shavkat Mirziyoyev’s visit to Navoi region in March 2017, the farm’s business project was reviewed. As a result, 394 heads of HOLSTEIN pedigree cattle were imported from Germany, Estonia and Denmark, and 40 local residents received employment. Later, 396 calves were obtained and daily milk yield reached 4000–5000 liters.

factory.title: Launch of the processing plant
factory.text: In September 2019, a milk processing plant with a daily capacity of 40 tons was launched using Turkish and German technologies. This stage created jobs for another 70 young people in the district. Today, the enterprise produces 37 types of dairy products and supplies them across the regions of Uzbekistan.

award.title: National recognition
award.text: In May 2021, the company won 1st place in the district, regional and national stages of the “Tashabbus-2021” competition in the “Best Farmer of the Year” category.

production.title: Current production and development direction
production.paragraph1: Today, the “Yangi asr” farm operates as a modern dairy production system with logistics and quality control. Safety, cleanliness and consistency remain central to the process.
production.paragraph2: The company’s path covers the transition from a farm operation to a major dairy producer. This strengthens the core values behind the SOFIN brand — trust, quality and a modern approach.

employment.title: Employment
employment.text: At different stages of growth, dozens of local residents and young specialists received stable jobs.

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.text: The plant can process up to 40 tons of milk per day.
